content.value_statement: PDF pages are difficult to convert when visual layout and extracted text are reviewed separately. This skill creates an ASCII layout preview for reliable HTML generation.
actual_capabilities: Combines a PDF page image with extracted text metadata for layout review.
Produces a structured ASCII preview with page boundaries and element labels.
Represents headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, spacing, and text hierarchy.
Adds summary statistics for detected layout elements and confidence notes.
Writes the preview to a predictable artifact path for downstream processing.
limitations: Accuracy depends on the quality of the page image and extracted text metadata.
The skill is instructional and does not include executable conversion scripts.
Complex visual designs may need manual review after the ASCII preview is generated.
Generated structure can be probabilistic because it relies on AI interpretation.

use_cases.title: Prepare PDF Pages for HTML Conversion
use_cases.description: Create a readable structure map before generating semantic HTML from page images and extracted text.

use_cases.title: Review Layout Extraction Quality
use_cases.description: Compare page structure, headings, lists, and tables before downstream automation uses the extracted data.

use_cases.title: Debug AI Document Pipelines
use_cases.description: Use the ASCII preview as an intermediate artifact when HTML output does not match the source page.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Preview
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one page with standard inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an ASCII layout preview for this PDF page using the page image and rich extraction file. Include headings, paragraphs, and lists.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Page Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on checking extraction quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the ASCII preview and compare it with the extracted text metadata. Flag missing elements, unclear hierarchy, and layout uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare HTML Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a downstream HTML generation workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an ASCII preview optimized for HTML generation. Preserve reading order, semantic headings, list nesting, table structure, and spacing cues.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Difficult Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for complex layouts or low-confidence extraction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this complex PDF page and produce an ASCII preview with confidence notes. Explain ambiguous layout choices and fallback assumptions.

output_examples.input: A textbook PDF page image with extracted text spans and font metadata.
output_examples.output: A labeled ASCII page map showing the title, divider, section heading, paragraphs, bullet list, and structure summary.

output_examples.input: A page with a table, body text, and mixed heading levels.
output_examples.output: A structured text preview that preserves table columns, marks heading levels, and reports detected element counts.

output_examples.input: A page where the image is unavailable but extracted text data exists.
output_examples.output: A text-only ASCII preview with a note that visual validation was not available.

best_practices: Provide both the page image and rich extraction data when available.
Review the ASCII preview before using it as context for HTML generation.
Keep generated lines short enough for readable inspection and version diffs.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the ASCII preview as a perfect substitute for source-page review.
Do not skip validation when source images are low quality or cropped.
Do not use the output for final publishing without checking text accuracy.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates a structured ASCII text preview of a PDF page layout.

faq.question: Does it convert PDF pages directly to HTML?
faq.answer: No. It creates an intermediate layout representation for a separate HTML generation step.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use a page image and extracted text metadata with fonts, positions, and element details.

faq.question: Can it work without the page image?
faq.answer: Yes, but the result relies only on extracted text and may lose visual layout detail.

faq.question: Is the output machine-readable?
faq.answer: The output is plain text designed for human review and downstream AI context.

faq.question: Why include confidence notes?
faq.answer: Confidence notes help reviewers identify ambiguous layout choices before later automation uses the preview.
